name: inktrade

scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -A run clean && rm -rf node_modules

_comment_resolutions: React is pinned to one exact version across every workspace. It has to be: @tanstack/react-query (and anything else peering on react) gets a separate virtual instance per distinct react resolution, which the node-modules linker then materialises next to each consumer. Three reacts -- 19.2.3 hoisted, 19.2.6 in web, 19.2.8 in client -- produced three copies of react-query and three React contexts, so the shared hooks in @inktrade/client called useQueries against a provider that web had set up on a different copy, and every chain page threw 'No QueryClient set'. The version is Expo's: packages/mobile pins react exactly, so the most constrained consumer sets it for everyone. Bump this alongside the Expo SDK, not ahead of it.
